name: 70809 · Baton Rouge, LA
findings: ZIP 70809 (Baton Rouge) has 243 nonprofit organizations. 129 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 111 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70809 (Baton Rouge) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 70809 (Baton Rouge) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 111 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
